name: Ascletis Pharma Inc.
summary: Ascletis Pharma Inc., a biotechnology company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of pharmaceutical products in Mainland China. The company's commercial products include Ritonavir tablet; and ASCLEVIR and GANOVO for use in the treatment of Hepatitis C virus. It is also developing ASC22 for treating CHB and HIV functional cure; ASC10 for treating respiratory syncytia virus; ASC10 and ASC11 to treat COVID-19; ASC40, ASC41, and ASC43F FDC for non-alcoholic steatohepatitis; and ASC42 for the treatment of primary biliary cholangitis.
